1.w: Of David, in his changing his behavior before Abimelech, and he drove him off, and he went. I will bless YHWH at every time; His praise [is] continually in my mouth.

2.w: In YHWH my soul boasts; let the humble hear and be glad.

3.w: Magnify YHWH with me, and let us exalt His name together.

4.w: I sought YHWH, and He answered me, and He snatched me up from all my fears.

5.w: They looked toward Him, and they shone, and their faces were not ashamed.

6.w: This poor one called out, and YHWH heard, and from all his troubles He saved him.

7.w: The angel of YHWH encamps all around those who fear Him, and he rescues them.

8.w: Taste and see that YHWH [is] good; blessed [is] the man [who] takes refuge in Him.

9.w: Fear YHWH, His holy ones, for There is no lack for those fearing Him.

10.w: The young lions are in want and are hungry, and those seeking YHWH shall not lack any good [thing].

11.w: Come, [my] sons, listen to me; the fear of YHWH I will teach you⁺.

12.w: Who [is] the man desiring life, loving days, that he may see good?

13.w: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.

14.w: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

15.w: The eyes of YHWH [are] toward the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.

16.w: The face of YHWH [is] against those doing evil, to cut off from the earth their memory.

17.w: They cry out, and YHWH hears, and He delivers them from all their troubles.

18.w: Near [is] YHWH to the broken of heart, and He saves those crushed in spirit.

19.w: Many [are] [are] the afflictions of a righteous one, but from them all YHWH delivers him.

20.w: He guards all his bones; not one of them is broken.

21.w: Evil will kill the wicked, and those hating a righteous one will be held guilty.

22.w: YHWH redeems the soul of His servants, and not any of those taking refuge in Him will be condemned.
